Traveling with Apple devices usually means bringing along a variety of charging cables and outlet adapters. The RORRY Flow power bank tackles exactly this problem by integrating all the features you need into one compact battery. It comes with a built-in wall plug, an integrated USB-C charging cable, and a magnetic charger designed for the Apple Watch. For me, this is exactly the type of accessory I love for vacations — it handles everything from on-the-go charging to overnight top-ups.

MagSafe Monday: Every Monday, Bradley Chambers brings you the latest news from the MagSafe and wireless charging industry, helping you get the most out of your wireless-charging-capable Apple devices.

Built for travel

The RORRY Flow power bank has built-in foldable wall prongs on the back, so you can recharge the power bank without carrying an extra outlet adapter. Just plug it straight into a wall socket at a hotel or vacation rental. It also comes with an integrated USB-C charging cable (love this feature!) — even when charging devices like an iPhone, iPad, Kindle, or Switch, you don't need to pack an extra cable.

Although I usually talk about iPhone MagSafe in this column, this power bank comes with a dedicated 5W magnetic charger designed specifically for the Apple Watch. When your Apple Watch is running low on battery, just place it on the power bank to top it up easily — both convenient and practical. The magnetic design holds the watch firmly in place while charging, so you don't need to bring the original charger.

The power bank has a capacity of 10,000 mAh, more than enough to keep your iPhone and Apple Watch powered throughout a long day of travel. For me, the real game-changer is the 40W output via USB-C. In an emergency (when my MacBook Air is powered off), this wattage is enough to top up a MacBook Air.

RORRY Flow power bank verdict

If you're looking to slim down your travel bag for your Apple devices, the RORRY Flow power bank is a solid choice. It combines a wall charger, an Apple Watch charging cable, and a USB-C charging cable in one sleek package that slips easily into a handbag or pocket.

You can pick up the RORRY Flow portable charger directly from RORRY or Amazon.
